text: The identity-color test adds three DEBUG-only 500ms waits with targeted no-arbitrary-setTimeout waivers before checking actual rendered pseudo-element colors or removal. Accepted source retains them. Describe them as the scoped attempted workaround, not a standard test delay or proof of an intermittent fix. Prefer a justified rendered-state readiness signal when proposing new waits; the source here does not establish a replacement signal. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep debug-only color waits as an attempted test workaround
